article.story: NEW YORK -- — Hassan Koureissi’s 18 points helped Fordham defeat Manhattan 80-61 on Tuesday. Koureissi also contributed five rebounds and six assists for the Rams (4-1). Lateef Patrick totaled 15 points, six rebounds and six assists. Abass Bodija added 13 points and eight rebounds. Josiah Sabino finished with 23 points, six rebounds and two steals to lead the Jaspers (1-4). Fordham took the lead with 3:34 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Patrick led the team in scoring with 10 points to help put them up 37-29 at the break. Up next: Fordham’s next game is Saturday against Portland, and Manhattan visits Miami (FL) on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
